title: Chatshire
tagline: Introducing Blockchain Data Search Wizard: Cast Your Spell and Unveil The Magic 🧙
description: Chatshire is a user-friendly, intuitive platform designed to simplify blockchain data exploration using your natural language without needing to learn SQL grammar. By leveraging the power of LLM like OpenAI’s GPT, we generate tailored SQL queries for on-chain data providers effortlessly. With multi-source API integration (currently supports Flipside Crypto) and post-processing techniques, Chatshire provides a comprehensive and diverse presentation of search results, making it easy for users to compare and analyze data.
how_its_made:
1. OpenAI's GPT API: Our large language model (LLM) used for generating SQL queries and post-processing search results.
2. Push Protocol: A protocol for automating batch on-chain data queries, scheduling, and execution.
3. Data-source API Integration: Integration with various API services like Dune and Flipside, The Graph (but not limited to) for seamless data retrieval and comparison. Now currently support Flipside Crypto as the first basis.
4. Web Technologies: The modern web frontend/backend technologies like React, Redux, Next.js.
